newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Uganda gets $26 mln AfDF loan for power project.
newsitem.headline: Uganda gets $26 mln AfDF loan for power project.

text.p: The African Development Bank (AfDF) said on Thursday that it approved a $26 million loan to finance an urban power rehabilitation project in Uganda.

The project will provide a new 130 km 33 KV distribution line between Apac and Masindi towns, 37 km of new 11 KV lines in the capital Kampala and rehabilitate 11 KV and low voltage distribution networks in Kampala, Jinja and Tororo districts.

The objective is to reduce power losses in the urban network by 15 MV through the rehabilitation of distribution systems in Kampala, Jijnja Tororo and Masindi areas, the Abidjan-based bank said in a statement.
The total cost of the project, which will be implemented in four years, is $31 million, it said.

The bank, through its soft-loan arm the African Development Fund, will provide 84 percent of the total, net of taxes and duties, and will finance all foreign costs. The government of Uganda will contribute 16 percent to finance the local costs, the statement added.
